body.p: A witch. There lived an old man and his wife. He and his wife had a son. The son went outdoors and began to paint his reindeer [OSV:] "iralÊ¼ mÉ¨qÃ¤Ëqi" - "spouses".sledge. The old man said so: "The witch will come to you". The son [OSV:] did not pay attention. He kept painting. He caught the reindeer, harnessed them to the sledge. He left."nÊ¼ennÃ¤ ÉsÉ¨qo" - "to stop doing something". He was going on the sledge. The witch was running. She came up to the man and started to scratch his face. And she says so: "My husband, my husband!" She climbed onto the man's sledge. They came home. She came into the tent. She is scratching the old man's face: "Grandfather, grandfather!" She is scratching the old woman's face: "Grandmother, grandmother!" The people were very much annoyed with the witch. They gathered to discuss how to kill the witch. The woman keeps sitting. "Witch, you are obedient. Stir in the cauldron." The witch ran. She tried to hardly stir the cauldron, but it was too far. "The fire will eat me." The old man says so. "Come up closer." No sooner the witch came up to the fireplace as she fell into the fire. While falling she said so. "After me people will die."
